(Search snippet content — aggregator; underlying polls are YouGov and Opinium, both approved sources)

As of 18 July 2026, the PollCheck 7-poll moving average shows:
Reform UK 24.0%
Labour 20.4%
Conservatives 20.0%
Greens 14.1%
Liberal Democrats 11.9%

Recent individual polls:
YouGov (13 July 2026): Reform 24%, Con 19%, Lab 19%, Green 15%, Lib Dem 13%
Opinium (10 July 2026): Reform 24%, Lab 19%, Con 18%, Green 16%, Lib Dem 12%

"Burnham bounce": Labour have seen a rise in support across the polls while Reform's position has weakened. Opinium reported a one-point increase for Labour and a one-point drop for Reform, putting Labour five points behind Reform.

Related: Labour overtook Reform in a national poll for the first time since 2025 (reported 30 June 2026).
